name: Guangzhou Metro Design & Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: This engineering consultancy, Guangzhou Metro Design & Research Institute Co., Ltd., offers specialized expertise in various projects. For example, its work encompasses the detailed planning of the two-story subterranean ChishaJiao station and its associated subway link for the Guangzhou Metro Line 11. Founded in 1993, the company maintains its primary base of operations in Guangzhou, China, and functions as a division of Guangzhou Metro Group Co., Ltd.
